name: Swinburne Student Emergency Hardship Grant
summary: One-off grant of up to $1,000 for full-time Swinburne undergraduates from low-income backgrounds hit by an unexpected event.
who: Local student enrolled full-time in an undergraduate, associate degree or UniLink course.
From a low socio-economic background and facing an unexpected event causing significant financial hardship.
catches: Applications are currently closed. Check the page for the next round.

evidence.quote: an unexpected event that is causing you significant financial hardship
